craft_notes: Sthāyin: synonym triad. Rows: gain then names. Read aloud: three-name toll.

lines: The day-starved moon-day alone — by special gain; but hold the after-rite's unbroken time on feast-day chief.
By after-rite's first rank: after-rite, image-rite, wheel-rite — one name in three.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tither eva viśeṣalābhāt anuyāgakālānuvṛttis tu parvadine mukhyā anuyāgaprādhānyāt parvayāgānām anuyāgo mūrtiyāgaḥ cakrayāgaḥ iti paryāyāḥ
